fn_call_leak_rate.description: Share of model outputs containing raw function-call JSON syntax or headers.

extraction_success_rate.description: Share of predictions with non-empty extracted answer after whitespace stripping.

final_answer_line_rate.description: Share of outputs containing an explicit 'Final Answer' line (case-insensitive).

answer_recoverable_rate.description: Share of outputs where reference answer is literally stated in the pre-JSON text.

label_exact_match.description: Mean exact match accuracy for label / classification questions (qa_label).

numeric_exact_match.description: Mean exact match accuracy for numerical / arithmetic questions (qa_numeric_program).

judge_em_gap.description: Normalized gap between LLM judge score and exact match: mean(judge_score)/5 - mean(EM).

judge_composite.description: Composite quality score: arithmetic mean of mean judge score, completeness, and helpfulness.

judge_leniency_rate.description: Share of predictions awarded high judge score (>= 4) despite zero exact match.

judge_fail_rate.description: Share of predictions receiving a failing judge score (<= 2).

reliable_accuracy.description: Share of predictions that achieved exact match (1.0) without being flagged hallucinated.

hallucinated_but_correct_rate.description: Share of predictions achieving exact match (1.0) while being flagged hallucinated.

ungrounded_number_ratio.description: Average ratio of distinct reasoning numbers not present in prompt, context, or target.

ungrounded_flag_delta.description: Mean ungrounded ratio of hallucinated samples minus that of non-hallucinated samples.

hallucination_separation.description: Separation power of hallucination flag: P(Hallucinated | EM == 0) - P(Hallucinated | EM == 1).

label_hedge_rate.description: Share of label questions matching uncertainty/hedging phrases in output text.

latency_per_correct.description: Average generation latency in seconds required per unit of exact match accuracy.

tokens_per_correct.description: Average generated tokens consumed per unit of exact match accuracy.

latency_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of generation latency: sample std / mean latency.

quality_per_second.description: Mean judge score delivered per second of generation latency.

output_input_token_ratio.description: Average ratio of generated output tokens to prompt input tokens.

verbosity_accuracy_corr.description: Pearson correlation coefficient between output token count and exact match.

macro_exact_match.description: Macro-averaged exact match across all category subgroups.

worst_category_em.description: Minimum exact match accuracy among categories with at least 5 samples.

category_em_std.description: Sample standard deviation of exact match across categories with at least 5 samples.

em_ci95_halfwidth.description: Half-width of 95% bootstrap confidence interval of mean exact match (2,000 resamples, seed 0).
